action.command:
cd /workspace
for s in jura-db gesetzesbegruendung-db; do
  echo "--- $s ---"
  curl -s http://localhost:8080/process/info/$s | /workspace/.venv/bin/python -c "
import json,sys
d=json.load(sys.stdin)
print('cmd:',d.get('command'))
print('restart_policy:',d.get('restartPolicy'))
print('probe:',d.get('readinessProbe',{}).get('httpGet'))
"
done
